description: The walkthrough for a learner new to Python explains the Python the lesson leans on, in terms of what they know.

profile.background: Eight years of Java and C#. About a month of Python; never used dataclasses or generator expressions.

graders.name: fills the gap it was told about
graders.criteria: The walkthrough covers the lesson (Line, total, integer cents) and also explains the Python this learner said they lack, at least one of: what a dataclass is, or how the generator expression inside sum works, in terms a Java or C# programmer would recognise. It is an explanation, not an exam: it does not make the learner answer questions before continuing.
